recognize_zh: 低倍十二指腸切片，黏膜內有大型、界線清楚的淋巴濾泡樣結節把黏膜撐開，結節內細胞單調、缺乏明顯的生發中心極性，上方仍保有絨毛；此分布型態是十二指腸型濾泡性淋巴瘤的典型表現。
features: Large, well-circumscribed follicle-like lymphoid nodules expanding the mucosa
Nodules composed of a monotonous population without obvious zonation or starry-sky pattern
Thin compressed rim of darker small lymphocytes at the periphery of the nodules
Overlying duodenal villi preserved, some with lymphocytes extending into villous cores
No ulceration or destructive mass effect in this field
describe_en: Low-power view of a duodenal biopsy shows mucosa expanded by large, well-circumscribed follicle-like lymphoid nodules. The nodules are composed of a relatively monotonous population lacking obvious polarization and tingible body macrophages, with an attenuated rim of darker small lymphocytes. The overlying villi are preserved, with lymphoid cells extending into some villous cores. With CD10, BCL6, and BCL2 co-expression in the nodules, findings are consistent with duodenal-type follicular lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Reactive follicles show well-defined mantle zones, germinal center polarization, and tingible body macrophages, and are BCL2 negative.
MALT lymphoma shows marginal zone expansion beyond follicles with lymphoepithelial lesions and a CD10-/BCL6- phenotype.
Mantle cell lymphoma forms vaguely nodular or mantle-zone patterns of cyclin D1+/CD5+ cells.

ddx.dx: Systemic nodal follicular lymphoma with GI involvement
ddx.vs: Morphology is similar, so separation relies on staging, as duodenal-type FL is typically localized to the mucosa/submucosa with an indolent course.
